qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Statutory network monopoly over ~11,000 km of high-pressure gas transport pipelines and 4 LNG regasification terminals in Spain. Insurmountable physical and concession barriers to entry, with inflation-indexed regulated asset base returns set by CNMC.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). Spanish gas TSO and LNG terminal operator faces Tier 4 regulated utility baseline (5-10Y) and severe Macrotrend 4 (Energy Transition) terminal headwinds from EU natural gas phase-out, declining domestic gas demand, and unproven hydrogen backbone returns.
qualitative.evidence: Spanish CNMC caps allowed financial return on RAB at 5.44% (2021-2026) and 6.46% (2027-2032), capping historical 4-year median GAAP ROIC at 8.15%. FY24 net loss of -€299.3M due to Tallgrass Energy impairment, recovering to €339.1M in FY25. With long-term gas volume decline under EU decarbonization targets, competitive advantage period is capped at 10 years.
